title: Virtual aquarium tank
description: One user's aquarium. Written by the dashboard, read by the PC and Roku builds. Readers also clamp values and drop unknown species (see pc/src/tank.js), so this schema is for the backend to reject bad writes early.

seed.description: Seeds reef layout and fish placement.

scenery.description: reef: rock, corals and reef fish. openreef: the same reef and fish with no glass, in an endless reef, seen from a fish's eyes. jelly: a backlit blue kreisel that holds only jellies (pc/src/jelly.js).

clock.description: Follow local time of day (lights dim at night); false keeps the tank bright.
